concept.concept: Silhouette of a hiker on a ridge surrounded by falling leaves with 'Peak Season' as a double-meaning tagline
concept.audience: Outdoor hikers who celebrate fall foliage season
concept.rationale: Fall hiking content surges in August-September buying windows. The pun creates shareability. Seasonal timing aligns well with the 6-8 week lead time from today.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "PEAK SEASON" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a hiker silhouette standing on a mountain ridge, arms raised in celebration. Surrounding the figure are falling maple and birch leaves in mid-air, creating dynamic movement around the composition. Solid color blocks: deep charcoal gray for the hiker and ridge, burnt orange, golden yellow, and rust red for the leaves, cream solid background. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition with generous white margin. Readable as a bold screen-print at 12x16 inches.
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, white, arched above the hiker silhouette, approximately 1.5 inches tall, crisp and legible from distance.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Peak Season' is a common generic expression used in everyday language to describe a period of high activity or demand. As a double entendre referencing both mountain peaks and the autumn hiking season, it is a straightforward play on words with no distinctive trademark character. The silhouette hiker and falling leaves imagery is generic outdoor/nature art with no reference to specific brands, characters, celebrities, or protected IP. No known registered trademarks for this exact phrase in the apparel or print-on-demand space are prominent enough to raise concern. Overall risk is low.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'PEAK SEASON' in bold, correctly spelled text. The composition features a clean silhouette of a hiker on a mountain peak surrounded by autumn leaves — all generic motifs with no IP concerns. Text is clear and legible, anatomy is stylized silhouette (no malformation issues), and the overall design is clean and suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Peak Season Hiking T-Shirt - Autumn Foliage Tee
listing.description: Celebrate peak season with this striking hiking tee. Features a silhouette of a hiker on a ridge surrounded by falling leaves, with the double-meaning tagline 'Peak Season' capturing both mountain elevation and autumn's best hiking weather. Soft, durable cotton blend perfect for trail adventures and everyday wear. Ideal gift for outdoor hikers who chase fall foliage and mountain views.
